mandatory_check: Transport file host deploy model and network inputs may create only bounded non-executable objects; no ingress endpoint owns executable-mapping or activation authority
failure_rule: Drop or quarantine malformed replayed oversized or unauthorised input with no task mapping listener registration or persistent side effect

mandatory_check: Assign content bytes hash acquisition channel peer identity time detected type declared type quarantine and derivation before interpretation
failure_rule: Keep origin-ambiguous or mutable input quarantined non-executable and unable to enter a trusted namespace

mandatory_check: Parse packet archive document executable manifest import and model formats only in a zero-authority bounded C4 domain with no JIT
failure_rule: Kill and discard the parser domain on malformed input limit breach or fault; retain no handles state or promoted output

mandatory_check: Canonicalise detected type and layout; compute content identity; enumerate every executable section import library driver and runtime dependency by exact hash
failure_rule: Reject ambiguity polyglots cycles missing dependencies parser disagreement and post-hash mutation while all bytes remain data

mandatory_check: Verify object and complete dependency closure against purpose-bound trusted signers rooted in C0; a name certificate or authenticated transport alone is insufficient
failure_rule: Reject unsigned wrong-purpose unknown-key substituted or corrupted objects before any executable mapping

mandatory_check: Check signer and object revocation expiry monotonic version rollback counter and deployment policy freshness against authenticated state
failure_rule: Reject revoked expired replayed or downgraded content and preserve known-good recovery

stage: Signed manifest and minimal dependency surface
mandatory_check: Validate imports memory map ABI device request and capability request against the signed manifest and selected deployment profile; unselected components must be absent
failure_rule: Reject undeclared imports drivers parsers listeners executable sections and dependency substitution with zero partial registration

mandatory_check: Compute granted capabilities priority ceiling CPU memory queue grant action and device budgets as a subset of signed request current policy and available reserves
failure_rule: Reject or reduce over-requested authority and refuse admission that would endanger existing RT reservations

mandatory_check: Terminate the C4 inspection instance and create a fresh C3 domain with new address-space capability queue handle and generation state; never relabel in place
failure_rule: Abort promotion if teardown is incomplete and leave no C3 process

mandatory_check: Map only admitted immutable code as RX admitted constants as RO and private mutable state as RW-NX; add guard pages and no inherited mappings beyond the fixed runtime ABI
failure_rule: Destroy the partial domain on overlap alias permission allocation or guard failure before first instruction

stage: Executable seal and no in-place code creation
mandatory_check: Deny user W-to-X X-to-W writable executable alias JIT self-modification remote debug write process write and raw loader operations; executable state names the verified content hash
failure_rule: Terminate the requesting domain or reject before permission change while existing code identity remains intact

mandatory_check: Start only the newly admitted domain through the scheduler with kernel-derived identity class provenance generation budgets and exact capability set recorded before entry
failure_rule: Refuse activation on missing or mismatched metadata; network shell model file and deploy handlers cannot directly dispatch payload bytes

mandatory_check: Enforce Protection Domain memory capability IPC scheduling quota provenance device and fault contracts even if admitted code is fully attacker-controlled
failure_rule: Contain kill and revoke the compromised domain before it crosses an ungranted boundary or accumulates authority across attempts

mandatory_check: Revoke and wipe the failed domain before reuse; keep the system image immutable; activate updates only through signed atomic A-B recovery and local trust-root ceremony
failure_rule: Remain on or restore a known-good image and keep remote input unable to alter trust roots rollback state or recovery policy
